$comment: Single source of truth for the Combobox API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: A text field that filters a list as you type, for picking one value from many.

options.description: The choices. Options with the same group are shown under one heading.
options.html: <div class="vin-select__item" role="option" data-value="…">, inside .vin-combobox__group for headings

value / defaultValue.description: The chosen value (controlled or not). Use onValueChange to hear about changes.
value / defaultValue.html: aria-selected="true" on the option, the hidden input's value

label.description: Visible label. Without it, pass an aria-label.

filter.description: Your own matching. The default matches any part of the label, ignoring case and accents.

hint / error.description: Help text, or an error that also marks the field invalid.

name.description: Adds a hidden input so the chosen value is submitted with forms.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Type to filter, ↓ ↑ to move, Enter to choose, Esc to close. In HTML, add data-vin-combobox and include vinui.js once.

examples.title: Groups
examples.description: Options under headings. Headings disappear when none of their options match.

examples.title: Error and disabled
examples.description: An error is read out with the field; a disabled combobox can't be focused.

a11y: Follows the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern with list autocomplete: role="combobox" on the input, aria-expanded, aria-controls, and a role="listbox" of role="option" items.
Focus stays in the input while you move through the list; aria-activedescendant tells screen readers which option is highlighted.
Keys: type to filter, ↓ ↑ to move (↓ opens), Home End PageUp PageDown, Enter chooses, Esc closes (a second Esc clears), Alt+↓ opens without moving.
When focus leaves, the text goes back to the chosen option, so the field never shows a value that isn't selected.
"No results" is a status message, so screen readers announce it.
